notes: The IPEDS unit 'University of Colorado Denver/Anschutz Medical Campus' covers the CU Denver campus plus the health-sciences Anschutz campus. Only the CU Denver campus offers a CS bachelor's degree, so that program is used. Public CS syllabi are scarce; only one 2021 course page was recoverable.
